rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.FlagErrorf/MutuallyExclusive, variadic CommandModifier like Pull, prShared alias; matches surrounding idioms well.
rationale.edge_cases: Blank path, requires --checkout, --list exclusivity, relative→absolute, cross-repo remote, ff-only pull warning and reuse-of-existing-worktree all handled; Abs computed twice harmlessly.
rationale.scope: Core feature done, but also folds worktreeCheckoutCmds into a new shared WorktreeCheckoutCommands used only by pr checkout and swaps localBranchExists for HasLocalBranch; mild gratuitous refactor.
rationale.readability: Clear names and doc comments; WorktreeAdd's empty-string sentinel and WorktreeCheckoutCommands returning a one-element [][]string are slightly awkward.
rationale.robustness: Errors propagate, no panics; sentinel arg in WorktreeAdd could silently pick the wrong mode on an accidental empty remote branch.
rationale.maintainability: Git arg lists for worktree add are now duplicated between git.Client.WorktreeAdd and shared.WorktreeCheckoutCommands, and the two commands take different code paths for the same operation.
